biggest_catch: Official userbrain.com states $5 per completed test (5-20 min, PayPal) but no official page states when testers get paid.
catches: No official Userbrain help-center or tester page states a payout schedule — the '$10 minimum, paid once balance hits $10' claim comes from YouTube reviewers and aggregators, not Userbrain.
A qualification test is required before paid tests; tests are first-come-first-served and disappear fast.
Only approved tests pay; quality review is required.
Test volume depends on profile matching; earnings are irregular.

c2.evidence: Official page: '$5 per completed test', 'speak your thoughts while going through a set of tasks for about 5 to 20 minutes', paid via PayPal. Worldwide.

c3.evidence: Free to sign up; no fee on official page.

c4.evidence: No official Userbrain page states payout timing/schedule. '$10 minimum payout' claims are third-party only (YouTube reviews, finder.com).

eligibility: Sign up as tester; pass qualification test; smartphone/PC with Userbrain app or browser extension; PayPal account.
